view.description: me (what this login may do), explain (why an operation was refused), users, groups

network_id.description: me: show what the role on this network allows; explain: the network the refusal was on

operation.description: explain: the refused operation, for example EDIT_CHECKS or NetworkOperation.EDIT_CHECKS

error.description: explain: Forward's 403 message, for example "Missing permission: NetworkOperation.EDIT_CHECKS"

user.description: users: one user by id, username or email

match.description: users or groups: a substring of the name

limit.description: users or groups: rows per page

offset.description: users or groups: rows to skip
